notes.title: Another Day. Another Stage!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everybody! [/b]
A new Stage. Now we've 15 of them.
In order to unlock all you need to get more than 20.000 Points.
If you already have more than 20.000 points, just play a level again.

We fixed some small bugs too and changed some things.
We add a button that returns directly to the start menu.

And that's it for now, we're working on new achievements, the next few days will be dedicated to them.

Some news is comming too, like a gallery and other things ;x That's a secret!

Once more:
Thank you for everything!

[b]A big hug.[/b]
[i]Ero Triangle Team[/i]

:lunar2019grinningpig:

notes.title: As promised and a little beyond.
notes.content:
[b]Here is today's update with not only 1, but 2 new levels, plus 4 new achievements.[/b]

We continue to work hard here and if you have some ideas and would like to share with us, we appreciate your cooperation!

One more thing: When we reach the 30 levels promised we will try to improve the existing arts.

We also offer 2 dlcs, one with the arts that can be printed and another with our OST, it is not a GREAT thing, but if I buy it will help a lot the development and maintenance of the game.

Again thank you very much to all!

[b]A big hug.[/b]
[i]Ero Triangle Team[/i]

notes.title: Release Update!!!
notes.content:
[b]Yes! We just launched and we have news![/b]
Following is a small update, correcting a bug that prevented one of the images shown in the screenshots from being played. She is now Level 11.

[b]ATTENTION: You must repeat some levels to be able to open level 12. They open according to your score, as well as the achievements.[/b]
[b]
We also added level 12 !![/b] and we'll try to add AT LEAST one level per day until we complete 30 levels.

It is also available for Win32 and we are opening up a place for linux users who want to do a beta test.

We thank all those who have acquired the game and contribute to our improvement.

In short we will provide letters and backgrounds, as well as improve some of the images already available in the game.

[b]A big hug.[/b]
[i]Ero Triangle Team[/i]
